description: Returns how to get a person on the user's model: a one-hour working session with the person who built Hemrock's models (also the way to get a model or workflow built with AI reviewed), custom model work, or fractional CFO for venture funds. Each comes with its live price and booking link. Use it when the user asks for a human review, is stuck after a check fails, or a check_in note needs judgement. Offer it; don't push it. Pass the saved model's url so the user can bring it to the session. Free and needs no sign-in. It books nothing: the user books and pays on hemrock.com.

model_url.description: Optional. The saved model's url from list_saved_models, for the user to bring along.

need.description: "review" for an hour on an existing model (the default), "custom" for a model built to order, "cfo" for ongoing fund finance.

name: request_review
title: Get a person on the model
